<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const categoryContainer = document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-category.category-default");
  const booksSection = document.getElementById("books-section");
  if (!categoryContainer || !booksSection) return;

  // Add a "Books" entry to the Type filter, in alphabetical order
  const bookCount = booksSection.querySelectorAll(".imgcolumn").length;
  const booksEl = document.createElement("div");
  booksEl.className = "category";
  booksEl.setAttribute("data-category", btoa("Books"));
  booksEl.innerHTML = "Books <span class=\"quarto-category-count\">(" + bookCount + ")</span>";
  booksEl.onclick = function () {
    window.quartoListingCategory(booksEl.getAttribute("data-category"));
  };

  const others = Array.from(categoryContainer.querySelectorAll(".category"))
    .filter((el) => el.getAttribute("data-category") !== "");
  const insertBefore = others.find(
    (el) => el.textContent.trim().replace(/\s*\(\d+\)$/, "").localeCompare("Books") > 0
  );
  if (insertBefore) {
    categoryContainer.insertBefore(booksEl, insertBefore);
  } else {
    categoryContainer.appendChild(booksEl);
  }

  // Hide the Books section whenever a different category is selected,
  // and hide the Papers heading and listing (filter box included) when Books is selected
  const sidebar = document.getElementById("quarto-margin-sidebar");
  const papersHeadingText = document.getElementById("papers-heading");
  const papersHeadingEl = papersHeadingText ? papersHeadingText.closest("h2") : null;
  const papersListing = document.getElementById("listing-listing");

  // Move the listing's filter box up into the heading row, to the right of the title
  const filterBox = papersListing ? papersListing.querySelector(".listing-actions-group") : null;
  if (papersHeadingEl && filterBox) {
    papersHeadingEl.classList.add("listing-heading-row");
    papersHeadingEl.appendChild(filterBox);
  }
  function updateBooksVisibility() {
    const activeEl = categoryContainer.querySelector(".category.active");
    const active = activeEl
      ? decodeURIComponent(atob(activeEl.getAttribute("data-category")))
      : "";
    booksSection.style.display = active === "" || active === "Books" ? "" : "none";
    if (papersListing) {
      papersListing.style.display = active === "Books" ? "none" : "";
    }
    if (papersHeadingEl) {
      if (active === "Books") {
        papersHeadingEl.style.display = "none";
      } else {
        papersHeadingEl.style.display = "";
        papersHeadingText.textContent = active === "" ? "All papers" : active;
      }
    }
  }
  sidebar.addEventListener("click", function () {
    setTimeout(updateBooksVisibility, 0);
  });
  updateBooksVisibility();
  setTimeout(updateBooksVisibility, 0);
});
</script>
